title: lattice.plan_scope_review.v1
description: AI-authored review performed after the complete plan is written and before it is registered. Every planned task is judged against the owner-supplied work specifications; task splitting and parallelization are allowed, but a new product purpose is not. The plan input may be a plan create input v4 or v5 (the template default; a missing schema reads as v5) or a todo extraction v3/v4.
$comment: Lattice validates complete task coverage, known work-spec references, verdict consistency, and digest binding. The operating AI owns the semantic judgment. authoring_digest and review_digest may be omitted: the machine computes both (authoring_digest is the plan input's input_digest, or extraction_digest, computed from its content); a written value must match.

work_specs.description: The owner-supplied work specifications. Do not add inferred improvements as work specifications.

task_assessments.description: Exactly one assessment for every task that will be registered. Use out_of_scope when the task creates a purpose not required by any work specification.
